desc: Our most popular model is the perfect protection for hikers, campers, fishermen and others that enjoy the great outdoors. Its chambered to fire both .357 Mag and .38 Special rounds, (also available in .45 Colt / .410). Features: Stainless steel double-barrel and frame. Compatible with all standard Bond Arms barrels. Automatic spent casing extractor. Patented rebounding hammer. Retracting firing pins. Cross-bolt safety. Spring-loaded, cammed locking lever.
